seeds.title: Ruined Portal at Spawn Shore
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #1. The reported Java 1.20.1 world spawns with a ruined portal visible near the shore and water; the local structure oracle confirms a ruined portal candidate at X=0, Z=80, 6 blocks from the submitted coordinates X=4, Y=65, Z=76.

seeds.title: Spawner Cluster and Notch Apple Chest
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #2 for Bedrock 26.13. Reported as lots of spawners in close proximity plus two touching chests with a notch apple in one chest. The app verifies the seed/version parse and Snowy Taiga biome at the submitted coordinates; dungeon spawner and chest loot placement still need manual in-game confirmation.

seeds.title: Minecraft Education Desert Temple Village House
seeds.description: Email submission for Minecraft Education. The 2/21/2026 Education client corresponds to Education 1.21.132; the local Bedrock-family generator confirms a desert biome at X=170, Y=73, Z=1298 and a nearby desert pyramid terrain candidate at X=128, Z=1152. The reported village house inside the desert temple still needs manual Education Edition verification.

seeds.title: Weird Looking Spikey Mountain
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #3 for Java 26.1.2. Reported as an unusual looking spikey mountain in the swamps at X=-208, Y=100, Z=272; visual terrain shape still needs manual in-game confirmation.

seeds.title: Giant Sea Large Biomes Spawn
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #5. Reported as spawning in the middle of a giant sea on small islands when set to Large Biomes, with total sea range around 400,000 blocks; reported to work from release 1.0 through 1.6.4.

seeds.title: Buried Shipwreck Inside Plains Village
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #6 for Java 26.1.2. Reported as a shipwreck buried in sand inside a plains village at X=590, Y=63, Z=-208. The original C cubiomes oracle confirms a viable shipwreck at X=592, Z=-224 (Beach, 16 blocks from the submitted coordinates) and a viable village at X=624, Z=-256 (Plains, 59 blocks away); final terrain burial/overlap still needs in-game confirmation.

seeds.title: Bedrock Trial Chamber Village Mansion Cluster
seeds.description: Email submission for Bedrock 26.13 found with Search Lab. Required structures were Trial Chambers, Village, and Mansion with any biome and a reported cluster distance of 597 blocks. An exhaustive local Bedrock placement scan finds the best viable triple at trial chamber X=136, Z=120, plains village X=-248, Z=312, and dark forest mansion X=344, Z=392; max pair distance is 597.4 blocks. Bedrock terrain/feature generation still needs BDS or in-game verification.

seeds.title: Landlocked Shipwreck on Beach
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #7 for Bedrock 26.13. Reported as a shipwreck generated entirely on land without touching water in a beach biome at X=-687, Y=67, Z=655. The local cubiomes-bedrock profile confirms Beach at the submitted coordinates, but 26.13 currently maps to the nearest available 26.20 family profile; exact shipwreck placement and landlocked terrain still need Bedrock Dedicated Server or in-game confirmation.

seeds.title: Dungeon Mineshaft Double Chest Collision
seeds.description: Email submission for Java 1.12.2. Reported as a dungeon colliding with an abandoned mineshaft, placing two single chests directly beside each other as an unusually generated double chest inside the dungeon at X=784, Y=32, Z=1058. The original C Cubiomes oracle confirms a viable mineshaft start at X=784, Z=992, 66 blocks from the submitted coordinates, and an Ocean biome at the submitted point. Dungeon placement, the collision, chest adjacency, and loot still need manual in-game or Java server confirmation.
